sys_ux_event.description: Fires when a row in the pinned drawer is activated (click or Enter/Space). The component then navigates to the Record URL template unless Navigate on pinned click is off. Payload: { table, sysId, label, url, data }.
sys_ux_event.label: Pinned item clicked
sys_ux_event.props: [ { "description": "Table of the clicked pinned record.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Table", "name": "table", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "sys_id of the clicked pinned record.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Record Sys ID", "name": "sysId", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Title of the clicked item.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Label", "name": "label", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Resolved record URL from the template.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "URL", "name": "url", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "The optional object stored with the item when it was pinned.", "fieldType": "json", "label": "Extra data", "name": "data", "valueType": "string" } ]
